IGNITE Myanmar Business Summit 14 November 2026 Yangon 300 delegates

The proposition

Everyone in Yangon is selling you impressions. We are selling you the room.

An impression is a number that someone was near your brand. A conversation is a person who now knows what you do and has your card in their pocket. IGNITE is built entirely around the second thing.

On 14 November 2026 we will put 300 named decision-makers from Myanmar banking, telecom, real estate, FMCG and business services into one room in Yangon for one day. Not a general audience. Not a ticket anyone can buy. A curated list, built name by name, of the people who sign.

This is the first edition, and we are saying that plainly rather than dressing it up. What you are buying is not a track record — it is the founding position in a summit that intends to run every year, at the price it will never be offered at again.

Why the empty room. Our campaign film never shows a cheering crowd. It shows the room before anyone is in it, filling one chair at a time. That is the honest picture of what we are selling in September — a room, and a list of exactly who will be sitting in it.

မြန်မာလို အကျဉ်းချုပ်

အခန်းတစ်ခန်း၊ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချသူ ၃၀၀

IGNITE Myanmar Business Summit ကို ၂၀၂၆ ခုနှစ်၊ နိုဝင်ဘာလ ၁၄ ရက်နေ့တွင် ရန်ကုန်မြို့၌ ကျင်းပပါမည်။ ဘဏ်လုပ်ငန်း၊ ဆက်သွယ်ရေး၊ အိမ်ခြံမြေ၊ ကုန်စည်နှင့် စီးပွားရေး ဝန်ဆောင်မှုကဏ္ဍများမှ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချနိုင်သူ ၃၀၀ ကို တစ်နေရာတည်းတွင် စုစည်းပေးမည့် ပွဲဖြစ်ပါသည်။

ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ရောင်းချနေသည်မှာ impression အရေအတွက် မဟုတ်ပါ — တကယ့် တွေ့ဆုံဆွေးနွေးမှုများ ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ ပရိသတ်ကို အမည်တစ်ခုချင်းစီ ရွေးချယ်ဖိတ်ကြားပါမည်။

ဤသည်မှာ ပထမဆုံးအကြိမ် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ ထို့ကြောင့် ယခုနှစ်တွင် ပါဝင်သူများသည် Founding Partner အဖြစ် နောင်နှစ်များတွင် ရရှိမည်မဟုတ်သော စျေးနှုန်းနှင့် ရာထူးနေရာကို ရရှိမည် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။

Sponsor အဆင့်များ ပိတ်မည့်ရက် — စက်တင်ဘာလ ၃၀ ရက်။

Valuation

How the price is built

We do not price tiers by feel. Each is costed from what the same exposure would cost a brand to buy separately in the Yangon market, then discounted for bundling.

Component (Gold tier example)Standalone market cost
Exhibition booth, one day, curated B2B footfall3.0M
Panel seat — speaking authority in front of 300 buyers4.0M
Logo on all campaign creative, 10 weeks3.5M
One branded content piece, produced & distributed2.5M
6 delegate passes @ 120k0.7M
Post-event delegate list + performance report1.5M
Standalone total15.2M
Gold tier price12.0M
Bundle advantage to the sponsor3.2M · 21%
Source discipline

Standalone costs are drawn from ZYNTH's Yangon event rate card and are marked [UNVERIFIED — Jul 2026] pending one confirmed quote per line. We will show a sponsor the working on request. We would rather be argued with on a real number than believed on an invented one.

Return

What a Gold sponsor is actually buying

300
Decision-makers in the room
40k
MMK cost per delegate reached
10
Weeks of campaign presence
1
Signed client to break even

The break-even test is the only one that matters. At 12M MMK (≈ USD 2,727), a Gold sponsorship pays for itself if it produces one client relationship worth more than 12M over its life. For a bank, a telco or a property developer, that is a single mid-sized account.

Compare it honestly to the alternative: 12M spent on Yangon digital media buys impressions across an audience you cannot name, at a moment you did not choose, with no conversation at the end of it. The room is a different instrument.

  • Measured and reported. Every sponsor receives a post-event report: delegate composition, booth engagement, content reach, and opt-in leads.
  • No inflated claims. We report what happened. If a metric misses, it is written down as a miss — that discipline is built into how ZYNTH operates.

The day

Run of show

  • 08:30 — 09:30
    Registration & exhibition opens
    Coffee in the exhibition hall. Booths get the room to themselves before the stage starts.
  • 09:30 — 10:00
    Opening keynote — Title sponsor
    The first voice in the room belongs to the Title partner.
  • 10:00 — 11:15
    Panel one — the Myanmar consumer in 2027
    Platinum seats. Moderated, EN with Burmese interpretation.
  • 11:15 — 11:45
    Break — exhibition
    Deliberately long. The exhibition is not a corridor, it is the point.
  • 11:45 — 13:00
    Panel two — building brands that hold
    Gold seats.
  • 13:00 — 14:15
    Lunch — seated, allocated
    Seating is planned, not random. Sponsors are placed with buyers.
  • 14:15 — 15:30
    Workshop tracks
    Three parallel rooms. Practical, not promotional.
  • 15:30 — 16:30
    Closing & networking
    The conversations everyone actually came for.

Agenda is indicative and will be confirmed with Title and Platinum partners before publication.

Next step

Two conversations, then a decision

We are not asking you to commit from a document. We are asking for 30 minutes to walk you through the delegate build for your sector, and to show you which of your buyers we are already talking to.

If the room is right for you, the second conversation is the contract. If it is not, we would rather know in August than in October.
